messages:
alec: FYI seeing persistent egress saturation us-west2 -> eu1 around 11:40 UTC. Dedicated pool latency spikes for a handful of tenants. trace id 9c3f
priya: which tenants? any noisy neighbor IDs?
alec: tenant-omega shows huge KV reshard traffic + tenant-streamers increased model upload bursts. 95p egress util at the peering link. Coincides with dedicated-pool-7 tail latency up 3x.
ian: alerted on link congest graphs: https://grafana.redwood/egress/peers?peer=eu1-usw2  — spikes look sustained ~20m
mariana: ops-bot posted this alert: "EGRESS_PEER_SATURATION us-west2->eu1 95%" at 1758123478 :rotating_light:
ops-bot: Suggested action: temp-route-dedicated -> us-west2-local fallback; open to manual carveout.
leo: Manual carveout would reduce throughput for bursty tenants elsewhere. What's the short-term SLA impact for dedicated customers if we reroute?
priya: reroute to local model variants reduces cross-region egress but increases cost by 10-15% CPU/GPU due to less optimal placement. For Dedicated SLAs, latency would improve but throughput per-slot drops slightly.
alec: short-term plan proposal: (1) apply soft-alloc egress-reserve 20% for dedicated pools on us-west2 egress toward eu1 (2) enable preferential routing for tokens with tag:dedicated (3) throttle tenant-omega KV reshard to 50% of prior rate for 30m
mariana: can we implement soft-alloc via the allocator without flipping routing policies? i.e. egress budget reservations per AZ?
ian: yes, allocator patch available: egress_budget_reserve_percent per-pool. I can push a canary. CLI:
```
allocatorctl set-pool --pool dedicated-pool-7 --egress-reserve 20
allocatorctl canary --target=us-west2 --duration=15m
```
leo: also need a comms plan to Sales + we should flag potential billing bump to Customer Success.
priya: agree. We should also run a quick probe to confirm no packet drops: run iperf from a node in us-west2 -> eu1 (iperf3 -c eu1-edge -t 30)
alec: i ran iperf3, shows 930Mbps goodput for most flows but a cluster of flows pinned at 200-300Mbps. Looks like queue-hogging. Output attached (snippet):
```
[  8]  0.00-30.00 sec  280 MBytes   78.6 Mbits/sec
[  9]  0.00-30.00 sec  3.45 GBytes  989 Mbits/sec
```
mariana: ok schedule: ian -> deploy egress_reserve canary (15m), apply tenant throttle policy for tenant-omega, ops-bot to monitor. If stable, widen to 50% of egress capacity carveouts and notify billing.
ian: deploying canary now.
ops-bot: deploy started for allocator patch canary (canary-id c-1758123456). Monitoring logs.
devex-bot: note — this will change routing behavior for dedicated-pool tags. Update the SDK docs perf note when we finalize.
leo: followup items: (A) quick postmortem template for cross-region egress saturation (B) run long-term proposal: dynamic egress QoS + paid reserve product (C) confirm cost delta for dedicated customers.
alec: thanks all. i'll triage the tenant throttle and ping sales/CS. update in 20m.
mariana: thumbs up :thumbsup:
ops-bot: canary finished at 1758123499 — egress peaks down to 60% and dedicated pool latency back to baseline. closing loop.
